title: A Data-Centric Approach to Detecting and Mitigating Demographic Bias in Pediatric Mental Health Text: A Case Study in Anxiety Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating classification parity metrics (False Positive Rate, False Negative Rate, Balanced Error Rate) across male and female subgroups, analyzing textual distributions (note length, Jaccard similarity, gendered word frequency), and using interpretability tools (LIME) to assess model reliance on gendered language (names, pronouns).

Evaluating classification parity metrics (Accuracy, False Positive Rate, False Negative Rate, Balanced Error Rate) and measuring textual distribution similarities (Jaccard and Familiarity indices) between 'White' and 'Other' racial subgroups.
